text_block_list.text:
Phew, I'm stuffed. I'd better get ready
for
tomorrow and get to sleep soon...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Hm? The electricity's out.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
It's all right, everyone! Stay calm and
remain
where you are!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Waaah! Someone save me! I'm so scared!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
I know that voice... Mayano?! Are you in
the
kitchen? Hang on, I'm coming for
you!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I have to close my eyes, focus... and
visualize the
dorm's layout!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
There! I have a good picture of the
space now!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
There are three tables along the wall,
and it's
about ten paces to the counter
from where I am...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Accidentally kicked the table
leg... I'd
better watch where I'm
stepping!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Okay! This open space must be the
counter! Now,
all I have to do is follow
along the wall to the
right...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Sniff... Hic... Fuji? Is that you?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Sorry I took so long, Mayano!
Everything's okay
now!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
...The lights are back on. See, there's
nothing to
be afraid of.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Aaah, Fuji! ♪ Thanks for coming to save
me!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I couldn't possibly have left a
crying
princess all on her own.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Gasp! I'm a princess?!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Of course. You're an incredibly adorable
and
diligent princess, at that.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, Fuji! You're just like a real-life
prince!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Weeeee!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Now, now, it's dangerous to run in here.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Hm, that concentrated focus I used
earlier feels
like it would come in handy
when running!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
The next day, Фудзи Кисэки runs more
swiftly than
ever in training!
